_doc: HeatShield demo roster — Lusail Marina District, 240 workers. EMPLOYER-side data (who is on the shift list); the network-side NaC fixture profiles live in fixtures/profiles.json. Names are SYNTHETIC combinations of common given/family names for each country and do not belong to real people. Phone numbers stay in the reserved +99999... range ON PURPOSE: no real Qatari MSISDN is used anywhere in this repository (see README).

_sources.lusail_city: Lusail, Qatar — 25°25'03"N 51°30'27"E (25.41750 / 51.50750), 38 km², 19 precincts incl. Marina District, Energy City 1&2, Fox Hills (Jabal Thuaileb), Al Erkyah, Qetaifan Islands, Seef Lusail — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lusail
_sources.workforce_mix: Qatar's migrant population is led by India, Bangladesh and Nepal, followed by Pakistan, the Philippines, Sri Lanka and East Africa — https://migrants-refugees.va/country-profile/qatar/ and https://www.hrw.org/news/2021/08/02/migrant-workers-and-the-qatar-world-cup
_sources.legal: Ministerial Decision No. 17/2021 — WBGT > 32.1 °C stops work year-round; 10:00–15:30 outdoor work ban 1 Jun – 15 Sep (encoded in packages/rules/config.py)

site.name: Lusail Marina District — Plot MD-07 (tower core & podium)
site.note: ONE perimeter, on purpose. Our own live measurement puts the platform's location uncertainty at 1000 m against this 500 m perimeter, so a smaller sub-zone CANNOT be verified from the network. The micro-zones below are therefore EMPLOYER LABELS used for WBGT attribution, crew grouping and the cluster test — they are never derived from a position, and no geofence is drawn around them.
